description: Main implementation for Bluetooth audio source recording to WAV file, including callback handlers, state management, and main control loop.

classes.name: context_t
classes.description: Holds context information for recording session, including file info, format, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: wav_header_t
classes.description: Represents the WAV file header structure used for writing audio data.

methods.name: on_configure_sink
methods.description: Configures the sink with the provided audio format, caching parameters.

methods.name: on_acquire_sink
methods.description: Handles acquisition of the sink, creates WAV file, writes header.

methods.name: on_relinquish_sink
methods.description: Releases the sink, finalizes WAV file by updating sizes, and closes file.

methods.name: on_change_sink_speed
methods.description: Handles playback speed changes, controls recording state.

methods.name: on_get_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current recorded time in milliseconds.

methods.name: on_get_delay
methods.description: Returns delay in samples; always zero for disk writer.

methods.name: on_frame_received
methods.description: Writes received audio frames to the WAV file if recording.

methods.name: state_changed
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth source state changes, logs current state.

methods.name: operational_state_update
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth source operational state updates, registers callbacks when available.

methods.name: ctrl_c_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to set user_break flag.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main program entry, manages Bluetooth source connection, recording loop, and cleanup.
